name: CRPErelation
description: CRPE (Comprehensive Relational Positioning Evaluation) is a benchmark for evaluating spatial relationship understanding in multimodal large language models. It tests models on their ability to recognize and reason about spatial relations (e.g., left, right, above, below) between objects in images, covering both existence questions and relation questions.
typical_sota_score: ~60–80% (frontier multimodal models; spatial relation understanding remains a challenge)
reputation: Specialized benchmark for spatial relation understanding in vision-language models; highlights a key weakness in current multimodal LLMs on positional reasoning
notes: CRPE focuses specifically on relational spatial reasoning — a known weakness of many vision-language models. The 'relation' subset (CRPErelation) tests positional understanding between object pairs. Part of the broader CRPE benchmark that includes both existence and relation tasks.
